title: Photography
learning_outcomes: Explain light and exposure in the context of photography.
Compare and distinguish framing in the context of photography.
Apply editing ethics in the context of photography.
Evaluate and justify decisions about sequencing in the context of photography.

lessons.title: Light and exposure
lessons.outcome: Explain light and exposure in the context of photography.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving light and exposure; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to photo portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain light and exposure from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of light and exposure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Framing
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish framing in the context of photography.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving framing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to photo portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain framing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of framing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Editing ethics
lessons.outcome: Apply editing ethics in the context of photography.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving editing ethics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to photo portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain editing ethics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of editing ethics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Sequencing
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about sequencing in the context of photography.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sequencing; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to photo portfolio.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sequencing from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sequencing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of light and exposure; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of framing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of editing ethics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of sequencing; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
